name: Nick Somers
office: City of Santa Clarita, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: He owns Nvisionate, a film-production sound stage in North Hollywood. He also runs a film production company, Utopian Films. He is a licensed emergency medical technician and volunteers with a search and rescue team.
